author: synced_reader plan, Task 7 (frontend sync engine)
summary: Added the reader's data-fetch + sync-math layer: a typed chapter_segment_timing contract, a fetch hook for the Task 5 serving route, and a pure derive hook that gates on the global player bus's scope/audioUrl before computing the active reading group and intra-group progress.

changes.change: NEW — ChapterTimingPayload/ChapterTimingGroup types matching the backend chapter_segment_timing schema (app/domain/chapters/timing.py) exactly, plus parseChapterTimingPayload (shallow shape validator, mirrors peaksSidecar.ts's parsePeaksSidecar).

NEW — fetchChapterTiming(projectId, chapterId): fetches GET /api/projects/{projectId}/chapters/{chapterId}/timing (Task 5 route), returns the validated payload or null on any 404/network/shape failure (mirrors fetchPeaksSidecar.ts).

NEW — useChapterTiming(chapterId, projectId) hook wrapping fetchChapterTiming with a stale-response guard (useRenderGroups.ts pattern) and a module-scoped Map cache keyed by `${projectId}:${chapterId}`. Only successful results are cached (deliberately, so a chapter with no sidecar yet retries on a later remount instead of being stuck 'unavailable' for the session) — no cross-render invalidation signal is wired yet; that is out of this task's scope (flagged in the task's implementer report).

NEW — useReaderSync(timing, playerBus, chapterAudioUrl): gates on playerBus.scope === 'chapter' && playerBus.audioUrl === chapterAudioUrl (read-only from frontend/src/store/playerBus.ts, not modified) before computing activeGroup/groupProgress/prev/next via a binary search over timing.groups on start_ms. Boundary rule: an exact end_ms/start_ms tie resolves to the START of the next group. Out-of-range positions (<=0 or past the last group's end_ms) clamp to the first/last group rather than returning null.
NEW — 200-with-parsed-shape, 404-to-null, network-failure-to-null, and cross-mount cache-hit-skips-refetch cases; mocks only global.fetch.

NEW — exact-start, mid-group fraction, exact end_ms/start_ms boundary tie-break (mutation-verified: flipping the binary search's tie condition breaks this test, confirming it exercises real logic), past-end-of-last-group clamping, scope-mismatch and audioUrl-mismatch gating, and timing===null-but-tracking cases.

invariants: The player bus (frontend/src/store/playerBus.ts) is the single source of truth for reader position; useReaderSync must gate on scope+audioUrl before treating bus position as relevant to this chapter, never assume the bus is always about this chapter (Booth/previews/book-continuous-playback share the same global bus). No engine-ID or plugin-specific branching here — this layer only consumes the already-validated timing contract from the backend.
note: Task 7 of design-docs/plans/active/synced_reader/ (04-roadmap.md). Backend Tasks 1-6 (contract, generator, orchestrator hook, serving route, backup/restore) were already landed prior to this task. Task 8 (ReaderView/ReaderContainer) and Task 9 (entry points + bidirectional seek) still need to consume these hooks; frontend/src/pages/ChapterEditor/ (Booth) and playerBus.ts itself were explicitly not touched per this task's scope.
